tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: List the AI Christmas styles: photo scenes, card designs and profile-picture (PFP) looks. Each has a preview image and a link that opens the generator with that style selected.

tools.name: get_style
tools.description: Details of one style: example results, the plain photo the preview was made from, supported aspect ratios and how many photos it takes.

tools.name: search_free_pfps
tools.description: Free, ready-made Christmas profile pictures (cute, matching pairs, aesthetic, funny) to download without an account.

tools.name: search_card_templates
tools.description: Free Christmas card design examples (family, pets, illustrated, modern) to download as finished JPGs, or to recreate with your own photos and greeting in the card generator.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Credit packs (one-time, no subscription) and how many credits each image costs by resolution.

tools.name: create_photo_link
tools.description: A link that opens the generator with a style selected. The user uploads their own photos there and signs in to create the image.
